title: Cafe Ong Tho menu
description: The orderable menu generated from the recipes repository's cafe.md plus the ordering enrichment config (menu/ordering-overrides.json). Encodes the customization model frozen for v1: temperature per item, modifier groups for milk (options may vary by temperature), sweetener type, the standard sweetness scale, and cold foam restricted to iced service. Notes and quantity bounds live in orderRules and are enforced again on every order line by the API contract.

version.description: Menu document format version, bumped on breaking shape changes.

orderRules.description: Frozen per-order-line bounds shared by both surfaces.

notesMaxLength.description: Free-text notes cap per order line.

categories.description: The five drink sections of the house drink menu, in display order.

modifierGroups.description: Shared customization groups referenced by items. Per-drink rules come from cafe.md.

items.description: Every orderable drink across the five sections.

identifier.description: ASCII slug used across menu.json, API payloads, and asset filenames.

temperature.description: Service temperature. Derived from the recipes prose, with config overrides where the prose cannot prove it.

nameVi.description: Section heading as printed on the house drink menu.

name.description: English section label from the house drink menu.
Display name spelled out to guests and baristas.

temperatures.description: Service temperatures at which this option is offered, enabling rules like Matcha Sua gaining cream builds when iced.

dimension.description: Which frozen customization dimension this group expresses.
